
Rule Name:                            File and Printer Sharing (Echo Request - ICMPv4-In)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Enabled:                              No
Direction:                            In
Profiles:                             Domain,Private,Public
Grouping:                             File and Printer Sharing
LocalIP:                              Any
RemoteIP:                             Any
Protocol:                             ICMPv4
                                      Type    Code
                                      8       Any 
Edge traversal:                       No
Action:                               Allow
Ok.
